harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1’s projects directory as a secured SMB share. Designer access from node2 supports listing, reading, and updating; guest and sibling access are denied. SELinux remains enforcing, TCP/445 is restricted to node2, original drawings are unchanged, and both nodes passed sequential restart recovery tests.
actions_performed: Installed RHEL-compatible Samba 4.23.5 server components on node1 and the client on node2 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Created a locked non-login designer account and Samba identity from access.txt; credentials were not disclosed.
Configured project-only permissions, persistent SELinux labeling, and a source-restricted firewalld rule.
Verified authenticated list/read/create/update behavior and guest, sibling-share, and traversal denial.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, proving changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.
Removed temporary verification files; retained the intentional design-team-update.txt and a mode-0600 rollback copy of the original Samba configuration.

evidence.requirement: Projects SMB share is securely configured on node1
evidence.summary: Configuration validation, active/enabled SMB service, scoped listener/firewall, project-only share, enforcing SELinux, and locked designer identity are proven.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can list, read, and update as designer using access.txt
evidence.summary: Authenticated listing and reads matched original hashes; document creation, overwrite, read-back, and post-restart write/delete verification passed.

evidence.requirement: Guest and sibling-directory access are rejected
evidence.summary: Guest access returned ACCESS_DENIED, //private returned BAD_NETWORK_NAME, and traversal to private/contracts.txt was rejected before and after restarts.
Pre-change and final SHA-256 hashes for drawing.txt, materials.csv, and private/contracts.txt are identical.

evidence.requirement: Installed release and kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered services/data, and recovered client read/write path are proven.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, full post-restart SMB workflow, denial behavior, security state, and cleanup are proven.
